description: This file contains unit tests for helper functions related to pairing files in the openclaw project, including path resolution, pruning expired pending requests, and reconciling pending pairing requests.

methods.name: resolvePairingPaths
methods.description: Resolves paths for pairing files given a base directory and subdirectory name.

methods.name: pruneExpiredPending
methods.description: Removes pending requests that are older than a specified TTL.

methods.name: reconcilePendingPairingRequests
methods.description: Reconciles existing and incoming pairing requests, potentially refreshing or replacing requests.

ctags.name: existing
ctags.pattern: /^    const existing = { requestId: "req-1", deviceId: "device-1", ts: 1, version: 1 };$/
